PRIVACY GUARANTEE

Zero Analytics & Tracking

Taskee does NOT collect analytics, telemetry, or network packets. All hardware stats remain strictly inside your local device RAM.

100% LOCAL PROCESSING
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I contribute code?

Fork the repository, create a feature branch, verify your code compiles with cargo check, and open a Pull Request. Please follow standard cargo fmt and cargo clippy conventions.

Does Taskee require administrator or root rights?

No. General CPU, RAM, disk, and personal process monitoring operates with standard user privileges. Terminating system-owned processes on Windows or Linux requires elevated privileges as enforced by the OS.

Is Taskee available for macOS?

Yes! sysinfo and eframe support macOS natively. You can clone the repo and compile with cargo run --release on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
